name: cf-cdn-per-domain-processor
description: Processes a single domain's full Cloudflare CDN configuration into an intermediate representation (IR) accumulator YAML file. Reads the domain entry from domain_scope.json and the source Cloudflare config to translate: page rules and cache rules → CloudFront cache behaviors; origin rules and load balancing → CloudFront origins; redirect rules → CloudFront Function snippets; response header rules → CloudFront response headers policy entries; transform rules → CloudFront Function snippets. Outputs ir/accumulator/{hostname}.yaml with all behaviors, origins, function code blocks, and policy settings. Must be invoked once per domain (parallelizable). Accepts a --domain argument to identify which domain to process.
